# Craig Callum
## Craig Callum
### Title
**Craig Callum** is a British Hot Wheels designer who has worked at Mattel since November 2022. He currently serves as design manager for the Hot Wheels line and designs cars for the mainline. Prior to his work at Mattel, he worked at LEGO, designing vehicles for the LEGO Speed Champions line.
